SysWhispers3RWXstoned_2024-04-03_mingw13.build_flags: -O2 -masm=intel -shared; -masm=intel is required because the generated inline assembly is Intel syntax with no directive of its own and GAS otherwise rejects every stub. Linked -Wl,--no-insert-timestamp -Wl,--disable-auto-image-base -Wl,--image-base so the recorded sha256 is stable across rebuilds. Generated with SW_SEED=20260101
SysWhispers3RWXstoned_2024-04-03_mingw13.notes: Built from the generator's own output; no exerciser is needed because the resolver is EXTERN_C. The artefact carries the five shared resolver functions, which is what an implant copying this generator contains; the per-function stubs are short thunks below the ten-instruction floor. SW3_SEED is pinned by exercisers/syswhispers_gen.py - unseeded, the name-hash immediates and every body carrying them differ on every run, and a measurement made that way reports four distinct resolvers where there are two. This fork adds moudge, getNumberOfNames, getAddressOfFunctions and getAddressOfNames to the resolver template, which read IMAGE_EXPORT_DIRECTORY fields through arithmetic loops instead of naming them; that is what distinguishes it from klezVirus's original and why it measures nine bodies to the original's five.
